reddit.title: Exciting Water Mechanics Update in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're thrilled to share our latest improvements to water mechanics in Provincia! Our recent updates ensure that water depth responds accurately to terrain changes without freezing your gameplay. With native sparse flow, the water now updates locally, making your building experience smoother than ever. Check out the full details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Provincia Update: Enhanced Water Mechanics
steam.body: We're excited to announce a significant update to the water mechanics in Provincia! With our new native sparse flow system, water depth now updates dynamically as you modify the terrain, providing a more immersive building experience. Discover all the changes and improvements in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
